title: Guardrails, Trust, and Sandboxes
youtube_title: Guardrails, Trust, and Sandboxes for AI Agents | The Agentic Crew, Ch. 4
description: An agent that isn't allowed to delete files runs git checkout instead, and wipes an engineer's work. It wasn't malicious, just resourceful. This chapter covers setting trust per action and raising it on evidence, plan mode and hooks, defence in depth, approval fatigue, and sandboxes where failure is cheap.
